samples.marker: Mirai x86-64 bot: correct syscall placement and watchdog claims

commands: rizin imports, strings, function disassembly and cross-references
method.external_sources: The two supplied tria.ge pages and MalwareBazaar page were inaccessible to the web reader; verdicts use original bytes and disassembly. No program-supplied payload or account endpoint was contacted.
method.dependencies: No fetched package dependency; three standalone native executables.

eupdate_evidence.equivalence: Identical mapped code/import/resource bytes at file offsets 0x400..0x21bff. Differences are fourteen unused DOS-stub bytes at 0x40..0x4d and appended hash-rotation padding.
eupdate_evidence.update_consent: VA 0x412964 fetches info.txt, reads version/downurl and compares versions. MessageBoxW at 0x412c6e asks in Chinese whether to update the ESET database-update utility; 0x412c77 requires IDYES=6, otherwise branches to 0x412f54. Accepted update downloads a replacement, checks MZ, replaces and launches it. Weak update authenticity does not prove a hostile replacement.
eupdate_evidence.decoder: VA 0x416bb0 uses out[i] = in[i] XOR key XOR ((31*i+7)&255). Constants and keys at its four callers decode to encrypt, type, /id.html and id.1yz.me. Account URL uses HTTPS port 4046. Remote accounts authenticate requests to um01.cn.eset.com; this is not local credential theft.
eupdate_evidence.mirror: Port 8000 HTTP relay. VA 0x4146c7 matches .signed suffix and returns HTTP 404; 0x417c40 filters SERVERS/LINKS/HOSTS INI sections. No client signature-verifier patch or malicious update substitution was established.
eupdate_evidence.other_capabilities: VA 0x415a8e..0x415af0 registers the executable under HKLM Run. ShellExecuteW runas uses normal elevation consent. Bind failure at 0x413108 onward triggers GetExtendedTcpTable lookup and termination of the port owner, with no security-product kill list. WinHTTP option 31 relaxes certificate validation. Preserve these neutral observations.
eupdate_evidence.hash_rotation: VA 0x4127e4 opens its executable, seeks EOF and writes 4..11 pseudorandom bytes. Standby mutation/relaunch at 0x415800 and scheduled handoff at 0x4171c4. Retain the existing suspicious trait. No concrete spying, stealing, destructive objective, deceptive activation or backdoor found.

mirai_evidence.reachable_initialization: main 0x401a90 opens /dev/watchdog or fallback path, passes WDIOC_SETOPTIONS=0x80045704 with WDIOS_DISABLECARD=1 at 0x401b11..0x401b2a, initializes tables, changes argv/process name to /var/Sofia, forks, setsid and starts attack_init, killer_init and scanner_init.
mirai_evidence.c2: Main creates and connects fd_serv at 0x402040..0x40209d. Its sockaddr immediate encodes 77.90.57.20:24981. 0x401f46 peeks a two-byte network-order length; 0x401fb0 and 0x402009 receive the bounded body; 0x402028 passes that same buffer to attack_parse.
mirai_evidence.attack_dispatch: attack_parse 0x402b10 parses duration, vector, IPv4/prefix targets and options, then calls attack_start at 0x402c30. attack_start forks and selects a registered handler by vector at 0x402ab9..0x402ad0. A second child sleeps for the supplied duration and kills the attack parent.
mirai_evidence.flood_effects: attack_init registers UDP, VSE, plain UDP, TCP SYN/ACK/STOMP, GRE and amplification handlers. attack_udp_plain loops over send at 0x408913..0x408932. attack_tcp_syn constructs raw IPv4/TCP packets and loops through sendto at 0x406583 and 0x4066aa. These are concrete network-disruption capabilities under remote tasking.
mirai_evidence.credentials: scanner_init initializes weighted login entries via add_auth_entry, sends random-address TCP SYN probes to Telnet port 23, establishes connections and drives username/password prompt states. add_auth_entry at 0x40aac0 decodes usernames/passwords with XOR 0x22, including root/xc3511, xmhdipc, juantech and smcadmin. Successful records are sent to a resolved collector on port 4115.
mirai_evidence.table_obfuscation: toggle_obf at 0x40c4d0 XORs every table byte with all four byte lanes of twenty key words. The effective key is 0x3a. Decoded entries include enable, /bin/busybox BOTNET and BOTNET: applet not found. Credential-table XOR 0x22 is separate.
mirai_evidence.huawei: huawei_init 0x409260 implements network probing and a connection state machine; 0x409c03..0x409c93 constructs/sends a POST to /ctrlt/DeviceUpgrade_1 with Huawei digest credentials and SOAP NewStatusURL shell substitution. It downloads /yeye/yeye.mips from 185.23.108.200 to /tmp/.oxy, chmods and executes it. No direct main-to-huawei_init reference was recovered, so this is retained compiled exploit capability, not proof that the module ran.
